title: The lane lint runs the mutation anchor pre-check, so a stale or ambiguous anchor fails before CI
why: On #1820 a mutant's anchor matched twice in hooks/guard_core.py, and it passed both review and `merge --lane-lint`; only the full mutation run catches it, so CI would turn red (lane draft-pr-guard-heredoc, session_013NEJKzzx35nAWSwPacHRXt, 04:15 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: `merge --lane-lint` runs mutate_guard.py's stale and ambiguous anchor pre-check on its own; it is cheap and runs no mutants. Red case first: a lane whose mutant anchor matches twice passes the lane lint today; control: a lane with unique anchors passes as today. Topic: lane checks. Related steps lane-lint-hook-suites and lane-lint-runs-local-tools. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Filed 04:13 CST Nov 8. Doing (lane draft-pr-guard-heredoc, 04:21 CST Nov 8): branch lane-lint-mutant-anchors from #1820's head e7c7e4461, Merge after: #1820. Sighting (coordinator, 04:42 CST Nov 9): #1717 changed an anchored line in guard_stream.py, passed lane lint, and went red only in batch 68's checks-mutate-guard job, which cost a batch rebuild (68d to 68e). The coordinator asked for a new step lane-lint-mutation-anchors; folded here, as this step is the same fix. Lane mutate-harness-change-timed-run (#2443, 13:26 CST Nov 9): the lane lint runs the checks-mutate-guard command only when a diff touches hooks/mutate_*.py or .mjs. CI's mutation step also covers hooks/guard.py, hooks/test_guard.py, bin/sim-lease and the other files hooks/mutate_guard.py targets (.github/scripts/ci-scope.sh lines 28-38). So a guard edit that moves a mutation anchor passes the lint and goes red in CI. The full run costs 11-16 min, and owner item 463 a names only the mutation test files, so this step's cheap anchor pre-check on those files is the fix. No owner question is needed unless the pre-check proves too weak.
